device.type: Reduced pressure zone device with strainer and isolating valves
device.location: Below ground pit beside the loading dock, northern boundary of the site

tests.finding: The relief valve opened below the minimum pressure and discharged continuously during the test. The first check valve did not hold the required differential, and debris was found in the strainer upstream of the device. The isolating valves were stiff to operate. Repair the relief valve and first check valve, clean the strainer, service the isolating valves, and book a re-test before the date shown.
